jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for Northern Dachas, an abandoned Russian cottage settlement. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, wide landscape 1536x1024, strict 4 columns x 2 rows of EIGHT equal 384x512 cells. Each cell contains exactly one completely isolated foliage cluster centered within its own cell with at least 35px transparent padding on all sides. No overlap across cells. No text, numbers, frames, checkerboard, ground rectangle or baked cast shadows. Camera: high oblique orthographic isometric, ground axes +/-31 degrees, detailed realistic hand-painted survival game assets, muted olive leaves, warm yellow flecks, coherent small detail, no cartoon outlines. Soft neutral daylight; light-facing upper left, shaded lower right. Row1 left to right: (1) dense waist-high bramble thicket with a few red berries; (2) airy hazel understory shrub with visible branches; (3) tall tangled meadow grasses with tiny white wildflowers; (4) wild meadow grasses with yellow flowers. Row2: (5) dense waterside reeds and brown cattails; (6) fern cluster and nettles; (7) narrow upright ivy climbing cluster suitable against a wall, no wall itself; (8) low scrub rose bush with small faded pink flowers. Real botanical forms, irregular natural silhouettes, detailed leaves. All eight must have actual transparent background.
